freeze.classification_selection: Highest macro F1, then balanced accuracy, then submitted algorithm order
freeze.regression_selection: Lowest RMSE, then MAE, then submitted algorithm order

external_audit.reference: Primary WHO monthly LMS: length below 24 months, height at 24; restricted WAZ tails.
limitations: No unique child identifier: No. is a source row ordinal; repeated profiles are not proven repeat visits.
Measurement position is unavailable; values are used as recorded, with age-based reference assumptions and no 0.7 cm conversion.
Monthly recalculated Z-scores are not exact-day clinical gold standards; supplied binary labels are preserved.
A single regional dataset does not establish national representativeness or prospective prediction.

source.title: Dataset Stunting and Nutritional Status of Toddler from Jeneponto Regency, South Sulawesi, Indonesia
source.cohort: Jeneponto 2024, source measurements; not a national sample

limitations: No tuning or fitting on external data
Source_Row is not a unique child identifier
Profile bootstrap cannot identify repeated visits or facility/family dependence
Source measurement position unavailable; age-conventional length/height assumed without undocumented corrections
Monthly reference-derived Z-scores are not independent clinical outcomes
One regency is not nationally representative

shap.interpretation: Global explanations of selected model configurations fitted on grouped fold 1 training; sample is fold 1 validation. Classification explains Stunted only; magnitudes across tasks have different output units.

scope: Current anthropometric status and reference-function approximation; interface-level integration; no prospective prediction or national generalizability claim
preprocessing: Gender encoding only for supervised models. Numeric inputs retain original units, including submitted unscaled Linear/Ridge baselines. Regional standardization is separate.
